paras: At Pelagic Marine, we understand the critical importance of compliance, operational integrity, and continuous improvement in the maritime industry. We perform systematic evaluations of vessel operations, shipboard practices, safety management frameworks, and navigational protocols. Our services are aligned with the latest IMO conventions, flag state requirements, OCIMF standards, and classification society guidelines.

We conduct systematic examinations of vessel systems, onboard procedures, and management practices to verify that your Safety Management System (SMS) is properly implemented and adhered to by the crew. Each audit is meticulously carried out to support safety, efficiency, and compliance across all levels of maritime operations.
